modules.name: layout_agent
modules.description: Agent that determines optimal layout and clustering for architecture diagrams.
modules.purpose: Transforms raw diagram specifications into semantically annotated, properly clustered layouts. Orchestrates component classification, importance scoring, zone clustering, and template selection to produce diagram views ready for rendering.

tools.name: ComponentMetricsBuilder
tools.description: Computes structural metrics (fan-in, fan-out) for each component in a DiagramSpec.

tools.name: ArchetypeClassifier
tools.description: Classifies a module graph into an architectural archetype by analyzing node connectivity patterns.

tools.name: ComponentArchetypeClassifier
tools.description: Classifies individual components into diagram types based on their role (caller, callee, child relationships) within the system.

tools.name: ClusterFallback
tools.description: Provides fallback clustering strategy by grouping components within a module by their role when primary clustering fails.

tools.name: ClusterValidator
tools.description: Validates and transforms raw cluster definitions into structured ZoneClusterPlan objects, ensuring consistency with module structure and layout styles.

tools.name: SemanticValidator
tools.description: Validates and annotates diagram specifications with semantic tier and role information. It processes raw component data against a DiagramSpec and applies fallback tier assignments to produce semantic annotations.

tools.name: ModuleGraphBuilder
tools.description: Constructs a module dependency graph from a DiagramSpec, mapping components to modules and resolving entry points.

tools.name: ImportanceScorer
tools.description: Scores component importance based on metrics and assigns primary tiers to components.

tools.name: SelectDiagramTemplateTool
tools.description: Tool that binds a DiagramSpec and selects an appropriate diagram template using TemplateSelectorService.

business.name: ClusterPlanner
business.description: Orchestrates zone clustering by computing component metrics, validating cluster definitions, and applying fallback strategies when needed. It coordinates ComponentMetricsBuilder and ClusterValidator to produce a complete clustering plan.

business.name: ComponentTypePlanner
business.description: Determines the diagram type for each component based on its structural role and connectivity patterns.

business.name: OwnershipResolver
business.description: Resolves component ownership and parent-child relationships within a DiagramSpec by computing metrics and assigning ownership based on component dependencies.

business.name: LayoutService
business.description: Lays out diagram components by building a module graph, classifying component archetypes, and assigning rank positions.

business.name: SemanticLayoutService
business.description: Orchestrates semantic layout by computing component metrics, scoring importance, validating semantics, and producing annotated layout hints.

business.name: TemplatePlanner
business.description: Plans diagram template selection using LLM-based reasoning with SelectDiagramTemplateTool.

business.name: TemplateSelectorService
business.description: Selects appropriate diagram templates based on diagram type and specification constraints. It uses ModuleGraphBuilder to construct the module graph and TemplateRegistry to retrieve available templates, then returns a SelectionResult.

business.name: TemplateRegistry
business.description: Registry providing access to diagram template definitions and their metadata.

business.name: ViewPlanner
business.description: Orchestrates view planning by coordinating ComponentArchetypeClassifier, ComponentTypePlanner, and TemplatePlanner to determine component types and template selections.

business.name: _TemplateBuilder
business.description: Builds diagram templates from module graphs and specifications, computing layout depth and constructing template nodes and edges.

business.name: _ViewBuilder
business.description: Constructs diagram views for modules and components by classifying component archetypes and building template nodes and edges.

modules.name: profiler_agent

modules.purpose: Analyzes repository structure by detecting modules, building file hierarchies, and validating against architecture blueprints to produce a structured RepoBlueprint for downstream processing.

business.name: BlueprintValidator
business.description: Validates and transforms raw repository blueprint data against the repository skeleton. It extracts module and zone information, validates architecture metadata, and constructs a structured RepoBlueprint for downstream processing.

business.name: FileTreeService
business.description: Fetches and caches repository file tree structure from a remote source.

business.name: ModuleDetector
business.description: Detects module entry points and package markers in a list of file paths.

business.name: RepoMapService
business.description: Builds a repository skeleton by detecting modules and organizing file paths into a hierarchical structure.

business.name: ProfilerService
business.description: Profiles a repository by building a repo skeleton, validating it against a blueprint, and returning a ProfileResponse.

tools.name: GetManifestFilesTool
tools.description: Tool that retrieves manifest files from a repository layer using FileTreeService.

tools.name: GetFileTreeTool
tools.description: Tool that retrieves the complete file tree structure from a repository using FileTreeService.

modules.name: render_agent
modules.description: Agent that renders architecture diagrams using placement algorithms and templates.
modules.purpose: Converts diagram templates into final visual representations by applying placement strategies from the PlacementRegistry to position components and edges.

business.name: PlacementService
business.description: Renders diagram templates by applying placement strategies from the PlacementRegistry to position components and edges.

business.name: PlacementRegistry
business.description: Registry that maps diagram types to their corresponding placement functions.

modules.name: tracer_agent
modules.description: Agent that traces code dependencies and builds call graphs for architecture analysis.
modules.purpose: Extracts architecture from source code by parsing AST, building call graphs, validating against specifications, and assembling evidence into a complete DiagramSpec with iterative correction support.

business.name: AstService
business.description: Parses Python source files and extracts class signatures, method definitions, import relationships, and HTTP call patterns. It builds a comprehensive import graph and identifies external API calls.

business.name: CallGraphService
business.description: Builds a call graph from entry point files by analyzing method invocations and dependencies.

business.name: EvidenceService
business.description: Builds an evidence bundle by parsing source files with AstService to extract signatures, then assembles call graphs and import relationships into a structured evidence dictionary.

business.name: FileFetchService
business.description: Fetches and caches source files from a remote repository.

business.name: GraphValidator
business.description: Validates a DiagramSpec against evidence by confirming that all components and edges are properly defined, checking method signatures, and verifying call/import/HTTP edge consistency.

business.name: CorrectionPromptBuilder
business.description: Generates a correction prompt based on validation failures to guide iterative refinement of the diagram specification.

business.name: HttpCallVisitor
business.description: AST visitor that extracts HTTP call patterns from class definitions and call nodes.

business.name: SpecAssembler
business.description: Assembles a DiagramSpec from a RepoBlueprint and raw evidence data. It constructs components, edges, and external actors, then validates and organizes them into a complete specification.

business.name: TracerService
business.description: Orchestrates the code tracing pipeline for extracting architecture from repositories. It coordinates multiple tools and validators: first fetches layer files via FetchLayerFilesTool, builds call graphs with BuildCallGraphTool, validates the graph structure with GraphValidator, assembles the evidence into a DiagramSpec using SpecAssembler, and applies corrections via CorrectionPromptBuilder before returning a TracerResponse.

business.name: ValidationResult
business.description: Model representing validation results from graph analysis.

tools.name: BuildCallGraphTool
tools.description: Tool that invokes CallGraphService to build a call graph from entry point files.

tools.name: BuildEvidenceTool
tools.description: Tool that invokes EvidenceService to extract and assemble evidence from source files.

tools.name: FetchLayerFilesTool
tools.description: Tool that fetches source files from a specific repository layer using FileFetchService.

tools.name: ParseAstTool
tools.description: Tool that parses AST using AstService.

meta.rationale: The system implements a strict sequential processing pipeline: repository profiling → source code tracing → diagram layout → final rendering. Each stage transforms its input into a structured output consumed by the next stage. The api module orchestrates this sequence but does not act as a hub; instead, it coordinates a linear flow of data and control through specialized agents. The varied zone structures and external agent dependencies reinforce this as a phased workflow rather than a layered or hub-and-spoke architecture.

This module has clear zone separation (tools vs. business) with multiple independent orchestrators in the business zone, each coordinating specific sub-tasks (clustering, layout, semantic analysis, view planning). No single dominant sequential flow or hub pattern; instead, four orchestrators handle distinct concerns with minimal cross-orchestrator coupling. Zoned layout best reflects this service-oriented architecture.

This module has clear zone separation (business orchestration vs. tool helpers) with no dominant sequential flow. ProfilerService orchestrates BlueprintValidator in the business zone, while tools provide independent file-retrieval helpers. The lack of runtime edges and the semantic separation by responsibility (business logic vs. utility tools) makes zoned the appropriate structure.

This module has a single zone with one primary orchestrator (PlacementService) that delegates to a registry. The minimal structure and lack of complex internal flow patterns fit the zoned diagram type, which is appropriate for service modules with clear responsibility boundaries.

nodes.description: Classifies individual components into diagram types based on their role (caller, callee, child relationships) within the system.

nodes.label: ComponentTypePlanner
nodes.description: Determines the diagram type for each component based on its structural role and connectivity patterns.

nodes.label: TemplatePlanner
nodes.description: Plans diagram template selection using LLM-based reasoning with SelectDiagramTemplateTool.

nodes.label: SelectDiagramTemplateTool
nodes.description: Tool that binds a DiagramSpec and selects an appropriate diagram template using TemplateSelectorService.

meta.rationale: Orchestrates a sequential workflow: classify component archetypes, plan component types, then select templates to determine final view configuration.

nodes.label: TemplateSelectorService
nodes.description: Selects appropriate diagram templates based on diagram type and specification constraints. It uses ModuleGraphBuilder to construct the module graph and TemplateRegistry to retrieve available templates, then returns a SelectionResult.

nodes.label: _TemplateBuilder
nodes.description: Builds diagram templates from module graphs and specifications, computing layout depth and constructing template nodes and edges.

data.label: AnalysisService
data.description: Orchestrates the end-to-end analysis pipeline. It receives analysis requests, delegates to ProfilerClient to extract repository structure, to TracerClient to build call graphs and evidence, to LayoutClient to generate diagram layouts, and to RenderClient to produce final visualizations, then assembles and persists the complete analysis response.

data.label: ArchetypeClassifier
data.description: Classifies a module graph into an architectural archetype by analyzing node connectivity patterns.

data.label: ClusterFallback
data.description: Provides fallback clustering strategy by grouping components within a module by their role when primary clustering fails.

data.label: ClusterPlanner
data.description: Orchestrates zone clustering by computing component metrics, validating cluster definitions, and applying fallback strategies when needed. It coordinates ComponentMetricsBuilder and ClusterValidator to produce a complete clustering plan.

data.label: ClusterValidator
data.description: Validates and transforms raw cluster definitions into structured ZoneClusterPlan objects, ensuring consistency with module structure and layout styles.

data.label: ComponentMetricsBuilder
data.description: Computes structural metrics (fan-in, fan-out) for each component in a DiagramSpec.

data.label: ComponentTypePlanner
data.description: Determines the diagram type for each component based on its structural role and connectivity patterns.

data.label: CorrectionPromptBuilder
data.description: Generates a correction prompt based on validation failures to guide iterative refinement of the diagram specification.

data.label: GitHubClient
data.description: HTTP client that fetches user repositories from the GitHub API.

data.label: HttpCallVisitor
data.description: AST visitor that extracts HTTP call patterns from class definitions and call nodes.

data.label: ImportanceScorer
data.description: Scores component importance based on metrics and assigns primary tiers to components.

data.label: LayoutClient
data.description: HTTP client that calls the layout agent service to generate diagram layouts.

data.label: LayoutService
data.description: Lays out diagram components by building a module graph, classifying component archetypes, and assigning rank positions.

data.label: ModuleDetector
data.description: Detects module entry points and package markers in a list of file paths.

data.label: ModuleGraphBuilder
data.description: Constructs a module dependency graph from a DiagramSpec, mapping components to modules and resolving entry points.

data.label: OutputPersister
data.description: Persists JSON and text output to files.

data.label: PlacementRegistry
data.description: Registry that maps diagram types to their corresponding placement functions.

data.label: ProfilerService
data.description: Profiles a repository by building a repo skeleton, validating it against a blueprint, and returning a ProfileResponse.

data.label: RenderClient
data.description: HTTP client that calls the render agent service to produce final diagram visualizations.

data.label: SemanticLayoutService
data.description: Orchestrates semantic layout by computing component metrics, scoring importance, validating semantics, and producing annotated layout hints.

data.label: SemanticValidator
data.description: Validates and annotates diagram specifications with semantic tier and role information. It processes raw component data against a DiagramSpec and applies fallback tier assignments to produce semantic annotations.

data.label: TemplateRegistry
data.description: Registry providing access to diagram template definitions and their metadata.

data.label: TracerClient
data.description: HTTP client that calls the tracer agent service to extract call graphs and build evidence bundles.

data.label: TracerService
data.description: Orchestrates the code tracing pipeline for extracting architecture from repositories. It coordinates multiple tools and validators: first fetches layer files via FetchLayerFilesTool, builds call graphs with BuildCallGraphTool, validates the graph structure with GraphValidator, assembles the evidence into a DiagramSpec using SpecAssembler, and applies corrections via CorrectionPromptBuilder before returning a TracerResponse.

data.label: ValidationResult
data.description: Model representing validation results from graph analysis.

data.label: ViewPlanner
data.description: Orchestrates view planning by coordinating ComponentArchetypeClassifier, ComponentTypePlanner, and TemplatePlanner to determine component types and template selections.

data.label: _TemplateBuilder
data.description: Builds diagram templates from module graphs and specifications, computing layout depth and constructing template nodes and edges.
